nodes.label: Card Slider Content Block Icon
nodes.description: SVG icon representing the card-slider content block. Shows a rectangular card layout with a blue image placeholder area (right side, 6x6 grid units) containing a white mountain/landscape thumbnail and a circular dot representing a photo subject, alongside gray text-line placeholders (left side, 3 lines) suggesting a card with mixed media and text. The overall composition visually communicates a slider card element with image and text columns, consistent with a carousel/slider UI component icon.

nodes.label: Card Slider ContentBlock
nodes.description: TYPO3 ContentBlock for a Splide-based card carousel/slider. Uses Tailwind CSS for card styling. Part of the sitepackage extension.
